messages:
Mira: Short thread to convert last night's postmortem notes into owners + concrete enforcement for safer rollouts. We need small, ship-first changes that cut blast radius and make canaries actionable. Listing candidates below, please claim or split and add a 1-2 line plan with ETA.

Candidates:
A) Auto-rollback policy + hysteresis (on high 5xx, request-error, OOMs)
B) Per-service max-rollout-percent enforced with audit/override flow
C) Canary gate schema + validator (latency p95, error-rate, perf regression)
D) Lightweight smoke-run during rollout (synthetic requests + golden checks)
E) Rollout observability tile + incident alarms for tail latency shifts
F) Update runbook + pre-rollout QA checklist and owner sign-off

Joel: I'll pick A (auto-rollback/hysteresis). Plan: add a gating layer in orch that samples aggregated 5xx and OOM signals, requires N consecutive windows over threshold before rollback to avoid flapping. Will include a config: `window_s`, `threshold_pct`, `min_qps`. Target: PR by Fri EOD, staging test Mon.

Benji: I'll take B (percent caps). Implementation: DB table `service_rollout_caps(service, cap_pct, requires_approvals)` + flag service middleware to validate updates. Default cap 10% for non-critical services, 3% for high-risk. Admin override path requires 2 approvers via Console. Backend PR by Thu, Console patch following Fri.

Lina: I'll do C + support E (observability). PoC: gate JSON schema and evaluator plumbed into canary controller; sample rule: ```{
  "metric": "p95_latency_ms",
  "baseline": "svc:stable:p95",
  "operator": ">",
  "factor": 1.25,
  "window_s": 120,
  "action": "rollback"
}```
I'll wire a golden-k8s-metric exporter to feed dashboard and create alert signatures for sudden tail shifts. Target PoC + dashboard tile in 10 days.

Samir: I'll own F + D coordination. I'll add the pre-rollout checklist to the runbook and draft a tiny smoke test harness we can run as part of the rollout job (3 quick API calls and a basic similarity/QA check). Runbook draft by Thu, smoke harness PR next week.

Mira: Nice. A couple of policy questions: do we enforce caps org-wide or opt-in per team? Also what should be default rollback thresholds? We need sane defaults so teams don't have to think on day 1.

Joel: Recommend enforced defaults with team opt-out that requires a documented risk review + two approvers. Default rollback: 2% absolute error-rate OR 3x baseline spike sustained for 2 consecutive 60s windows. Include `cooldown` to avoid immediate re-deploys.

Benji: Agree on enforced defaults. We'll add audit logs & a small UI that shows who approved overrides and why. For DB migration I'll add a backfill to set defaults.

Lina: Also suggest ramp steps: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over configurable time windows with metric gates between steps. This limits sudden exposure.

deploy-bot: NOTE: last night's incident had a canary ramp from 0% to 50% in 2 minutes — automated rollback didn't trigger because threshold config was missing. We should add a validation to block >step_max if no gates present.

Mira: Good catch. Let's add blocking validation: if rollout plan exceeds `max_step_percent` and no gates defined, orchestrator rejects the plan. Benji, add DB flag `require_gates` default true for production services.

Joel: I'll also write a short RFC paragraph on hysteresis, gating schema, and a minimal `rollback_reason` event payload for incident automation.

Samir: I'll schedule a 30m follow-up sync Thu 10am to review PRs and roadblocks. Invite sent.

Benji: I'll open the cap schema PR tonight and include a migration plan.

Lina: Posting PoC notes + sample queries here when ready. Also will add example alert thresholds and sample Grafana panels to the dashboard PR.

Mira: I'll create a tracker: https://go/redwood/issue/INC-2301 and add all owners + dates. Please paste PR/issue links into that ticket and tag me. If we get blocked on infra quotas ping #eng-infra and cc me.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add the rollout changes to the audit log stream; retention will be 90 days by default.

Mira: Great work team. Priorities: ship small safe defaults this sprint, make overrides intentional and auditable, and add quick observability so oncall can spot tail-regressions earlier. Ping in-thread for micro updates. :white_check_mark:
